g1.necessity: A process can die after a durable file edit but before run.end, leaving an unknown Provider attempt. Automatic replay risks duplicate effects and unbounded budget use. A deterministic read-only reconciliation is required before a human considers a new authorization.

g2.authority_owner: Existing TaskBudgetStore CAS, EventStore execution journal, signed Web T1 operator config and read_file/edit_file snapshot CAS
g2.non_duplication: No new authority, second budget ledger, background recovery daemon, new Web route or automatic resume. The CLI only reads existing facts and emits a HOLD or advisory operator-action-required receipt.

g3.recovery_or_reason: The real M4-C SIGKILL source with one dispatched Provider remains HOLD; a synthetic fully settled source may only pass advisory preflight. Any missing, mismatched, unknown or changed durable evidence vetoes new authorization. A fresh operator grant and Session are separate manual actions.

g4.rollback: Revert the isolated branch's script/tests/design/receipt/governance additions; no deployed state, source session or budget liability is rewritten or cleared.
